# Interest Rate and Default Risk Review 2026

This document details key actions required for the Credit & Loans department concerning interest rates and risk management for strategy 2026.

*   We need to update the interest rates quarterly.
*   We need to review the default risk for strategy 2026.
*   We need to optimize the interest rates standard update.
*   We need to update the interest rates for strategy 2026.
*   We need to optimize the interest rates for strategy 2026.
